title: Hearing on immigrant affairs budget and management report
summary: The Council holds preliminary budget hearings for Fiscal Year 2027, covering the Office of Immigrant Affairs and other agencies. The hearings also examine the Preliminary Capital Plan for Fiscal Years 2027-2030 and the Fiscal 2026 Preliminary Mayor's Management Report. The Office of Immigrant Affairs session is scheduled for 12:30 p.m. and a public session for 3:00 p.m.
